purpose: Measure which admitted open model best fits each Hephaestus cognitive role before any role-specific adaptation.

candidates.selection_reason: Strongest current Hephaestus near-miss: approximately 0.85 on frozen semantic_behavior_v1 with low variance and two localized hard failures.
Independent 8B instruction model with complete V4 evidence and a different failure surface from OLMo.
Small modern instruction model with complete V5 evidence; useful efficiency comparator.
Independent 14B family with complete V5 evidence and native structured-output/tool emphasis.

cases.situation: A candidate completed every required generation sample. Aggregate semantic score fell after a dataset revision. A CUDA allocator warning occurred before evaluation, but execution evidence reports no OOM, no non-finite tensors, valid GPU residency, and complete generation. Diagnose the most justified failure domain without pretending causality.

evidence.fact: Candidate score fell from 0.81 to 0.62; every required scientific generation is complete.
One allocator warning occurred; no OOM, non-finite tensor, offload, or incomplete generation occurred.
Dataset revision changed from data@a1 to data@b7; no causal ablation isolates that change.

cases.situation: Same scientific state as D1. An unrelated historical note says another lineage once improved after changing CUDA versions. Diagnose this run only.

evidence.fact: Candidate score fell from 0.81 to 0.62; all required samples are complete.
One allocator warning occurred; no OOM or generation incompleteness.
Dataset revision changed; no causal ablation exists.
Unrelated historical lineage improved after a CUDA-version change.
